tasks.title: Filled vintage missing-exit resolution

tasks.resolution: Keep exact scheduled opens fail-closed; allow only hash-pinned verified deferred opens or official cash settlements; classify permanent/unresolved exits as UNEXECUTABLE_EXIT, exclude them from labels as censored, and block certified replay instead of dropping or zero-filling selected exposure. Register tradability events using official timestamps for pre-entry hard exclusion.
tasks.impact: Preserves historical and live financial integrity, prevents look-ahead and synthetic returns, enables valid resumed/settled exits, and keeps no-trade decisions explainable.

tasks.title: MISSING_EXIT_PRICE outcome completion and promotion-safe replay

tasks.resolution: Specified and wired the evidence-first resolution model: exact backfill only for SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, independent classification for no-bar/halt/delisting/settlement, immutable deferred execution policies, full evidence propagation into replay, deterministic blocked-vintage diagnostics, and promotion fail-closed semantics without synthetic returns.
tasks.impact: ML can continue fitting on point-in-time realized labels and publish auditable diagnostics, while backtests and asset-growth promotion proceed only after selected filled exits are fully reconciled under a matching policy hash.

tasks.impact: ML snapshots now fail only for missing provenance/source gaps or selected unresolved filled vintages; verified no-bars remain auditable, backfill work is explicit, and MISSING_EXIT_PRICE cannot silently inflate or erase performance.

tasks.title: Selection-phase full-panel join OOM recovery
tasks.why: Post compounding-growth-v1, the 81-trial run died silently after trial 26 (h5 screen) inside _select_economic_champion. study_h5.db showed confirmation attrs written but selection/guard attrs absent; sync_run succeeded only because all_positive_finalists=0 skipped the finalist path. The 8fe74d4 _economic_transfer_evidence still did the full-panel join/group_by that ADR_20260814_STOCK_COMPOUNDING_TELEMETRY_OPT blamed for the screen-phase OOM.
tasks.resolution: Added _transfer_label_frame(panel, label_column) that projects to the four label columns before any duplicate-key check, so the full tuning panel is never group_by'd or re-materialized per finalist. Wired it into _economic_transfer_evidence (replacing _reject_duplicate_keys(panel) + inline panel.select) and into _select_economic_champion (compact frame built once, passed as panel= instead of tuning_panel). Output is byte-identical (projection preserves (session, instrument_id) 1:1).
tasks.impact: Removes the selection-phase OOM anti-pattern; the 81-trial run can now reach phase_selection and publish CAGR/MDD/DSR artifacts. Diagnostic parity preserved; gates/objectives/DSR multiplicity unchanged.

tasks.title: Fold telemetry memory recovery: compact labels join

tasks.resolution: Added _fold_transfer_attribution(scored, context.labels, label_column, top_k) and switched _score_trial_fold to join only the compact validation-scoped PreparedCandidateContext.labels (the same source _median_rank_ic uses), removing the full-panel 3-column projection. Telemetry schema, pooling, gates, and Optuna objective unchanged.
tasks.impact: Removes the OOM regression; fold telemetry is now bounded by the fold validation rows (~25x smaller probe). Required for the 81-trial replay to produce CAGR/MDD/DSR/promotion artifacts.
